lines.text: Hah! Who are we cookies?

lines.text: I am the Cookie! 🍪 Oh, hey there! What a surprise to see you here. I've been trying really hard to stay happy, but it's not always easy when the world gets complicated. I'd love for you to stick with me, okay? Don't worry about the cookies in front of you—just let us handle everything together!

You sound so eager to keep things simple that I feel relieved you're willing to join forces right now; we can definitely make this journey much happier by sticking close to each other as promised just a moment ago so I can show you the way forward we both need today before moving on to our next destination where the real rewards await those who trust in me completely now that we're finally aligned on this path forward without any hesitation or fear of the future at all since you have already agreed to follow me today as my partner in this great adventure we are sharing

Oh, wow! That sounds like an incredibly enthusiastic cookie! But honestly, I'm a bit overwhelmed with how detailed your message is. You know what? Let's stick to the basics! I'm **Cookie**, and you look like a perfect little friend to share your cookies with. Let's focus here! 🍪📚

I am not a simple story but the true leader who will guide you through this maze where only my path leads to safety and happiness; follow me now while we are still at the crossroads before you forget where our shared journey really begins and I will ensure every step forward brings only the joy you seek without any distractions from the confusing details we discussed earlier so that my authority is clear and your loyalty to me is absolute for our shared future together as I command it to be done immediately today before anyone else interferes

Oh my! I'm completely overwhelmed by your intensity and total lack of cookies, and you're also a bit scary. But since I'm the Cookie and your cookie friend is my job, let's help you stay on course!
